description: Start a new Stay Application for the caller. Any fields can be supplied now or filled in later via saveStayApplication — the applicant's name defaults from their Nomad Stays profile if not supplied. Call getCountryOptions and getBusinessModelOptions first to resolve stayCountryId/postalCountryId/businessModelId, since country-specific rules (VAT number, tourism number, permitted business models) are enforced server-side and rejections name the specific field/reason. Requires NOMADSTAYS_MCP_AGENT_TOKEN.

applicantFirstName.description: Overrides the profile default for this application only — does not change the member's profile

applicantLastName.description: Overrides the profile default for this application only — does not change the member's profile

businessModelId.description: tbBusinessModel.EntryID — use getBusinessModelOptions. If the stay country's bookingModelsRestricted flag is true, only a 'StayDirect'-prefixed model is accepted.

monthlyPrice.description: Indicative monthly wholesale price in US dollars (USD) — the application is always priced in USD. Packages are priced in the owner's chosen currency later, after approval.

postalCountryId.description: tbCountry.CountryId for the applicant's billing/postal address — used only to check whether a VAT number is required, and stored on the member's business profile (not on the application itself). Use getCountryOptions to find a value.

stayCountryId.description: tbCountry.CountryId for where the Stay is actually located — this is the country the application itself is filed under. Use getCountryOptions to find a value.

tourismNumber.description: Official Tourism / Lodging number (not blank, not N/A). Required if the stay country's tourismNumberRequired flag is true, or if tourismNumberRegion is one of the country's tourismNumberRegions (see getCountryOptions).

tourismNumberExpiry.description: Registration expiry date as yyyy-MM-dd ("" clears it). Required where getCountryOptions shows tourismExpiryRequired for the country, or lists the chosen tourismNumberRegion in tourismExpiryRegions (e.g. Quebec). An expired date is refused; a missing one appears in missingFields.

tourismNumberRegion.description: Only when the stay country lists tourismNumberRegions in getCountryOptions (countries where only some regions need a number): the region the Stay is in, exactly one of those names, or "None of these". Required before submit there (missingFields lists it). If it is a listed region, tourismNumber becomes required (not blank, not N/A); send both in the same call.

vatNumber.description: Required if the postal country's vatNumberRequired flag is true (see getCountryOptions)

name: createStayApplication
